title.narrative: BMGF Sanitation through Climate Resilience and Green Growth Phase II

description.narrative: Active

The funding agreement was signed on 17 August and the project is ongoing. However, as this is an Africa regional office project, this idea is created to enable code change from GP to ROC code and facilitate the process going forward. The proposed project aims to contribute to reducing GHG emissions from the sanitation sector and improving livelihoods by mainstreaming sanitation into national development planning, creating an enabling environment for sustainable infrastructure investments and operations including through improved access to climate financing, and regional knowledge sharing.
